items.title: MECH-286 sleep-onset three-term conjunction signature (GOV-CONFIRM-1)
items.note: GOV-CONFIRM-1 confirmer (IGW-20260804-234, stable_hash 318044a8a934). First SCORING experimental evidence for MECH-286: prior v3_exq_599a was experiment_purpose=diagnostic (substrate smoke, no evidence_class) and scored 0. Wall-independent representational-signature DV = the gate's own three-term conjunction read directly via evaluate_sleep_onset_permit (NOT a behavioural/reward proxy). 2x2x2 factorial over override / MECH-284 staleness / z_harm_a-tonic-threat, all three independently manipulated; the z_harm_a threat conjunct is NOVEL (599a never exercised it, threat_ok defaulted True). Tests necessity of each term (override-block cell = the claim's pre-registered hyperarousal-lesion falsifier), sufficiency, and single-term insufficiency; C5 load-bearing = full 8-cell permitted vector == predicted AND across all seeds. Anti-tautology non-degeneracy guard: each factor's two levels must straddle its threshold (override driven through the REAL SD-037 regulator dynamics, not pinned). DV-symmetry: each manipulation moves a term across its own gate threshold, flipping its _ok flag -> the delta is NOT invariant under the DV (designed to flip the gate), so no arm is an arithmetic identity. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout absent from all scoring manifests, not post-hoc derivable -> run required. New number, not a lettered fix to 599/599a (new question). Substrate built (ree_core/sleep/sleep_onset_gate.py, flag use_mech286_sleep_onset_gate). Smoke PASS on Mac (all criteria + non_degenerate).
